relations.role: Assistant Keeper of Oriental Prints and Manuscripts
relations.evidence: in 1913 he was appointed Assistant Keeper of Oriental Prints and Manuscripts at the British Museum... Waley left the British Museum in 1929

relations.subject: Arthur David Waley
relations.evidence: Waley's supervisor at the museum was the poet and scholar Laurence Binyon, and under his nominal tutelage, Waley taught himself to read Classical Chinese and Classical Japanese

relations.subject: Arthur David Waley
relations.evidence: Waley entered into a lifelong relationship with the English ballet dancer, orientalist, dance critic, and dance researcher Beryl de Zoete, whom he met in 1918

relations.subject: Arthur David Waley
